plans.note: Consequential/indirect damages waiver at p0242 (loss of traffic, business, anticipated savings); PG members' non-liability at p0126. No monetary aggregate cap located; confirm mutuality and carve-outs (indemnity p0241).

Reciprocal Party-to-Party indemnity at 21.2 (p0241) plus Settlement of Claims regime (§32: p0275, p0279, p0280). Consortium structure means mutual rather than vendor-side indemnity; assess proportionality to Investment Share and IP-claim coverage.
No restraint on our other businesses found; p0206/p0208 are permissive ('without any restrictions') and favour us. Confirm no covenant limiting participation in competing cable systems.
Only 'sole and exclusive remedy' in dispute clause (p0262) — a remedies limitation, not purchasing exclusivity. Check §§11-12 for any de facto routing/purchase requirement.
No MFN/best-terms covenant found. p0225 requires 'reasonable and non-discriminatory' arrangements — even-handed, not an MFN burden on us; likely note-only.
Searches for solicit, hire, employ, personnel, staff, recruit, employment returned nothing. Treat as absent; not expected in this agreement type.

§18 exit regime: termination of participation only at end of 25-year Initial Period or thereafter (p0228), unanimous written agreement during Initial Period (p0229), no capital-cost credit on such termination (p0233). Assess lock-in and forfeiture.

No classic auto-renewal with uplift; term continues after the 25-year Initial Period until decommissioning/termination by agreement (p0228, p0230, p0231). Assess continuation-by-default and exit notice.

§27 (p0029, p0262) refers disputes to the Management Committee, which may determine the method such as arbitration, and is the sole and exclusive remedy. No express governing law or court venue located; confirm absence and evaluate against accepted-law/courts position.

§22 (p0246) restricts assignment except as provided in Paragraph 12 and specified subparagraphs; §30 (p0269) binds successors and permitted assigns. Check affiliate assignment freedom and change-of-control consequences; capacity transfer rights at p0189, p0206, p0210.

Ownership is asset/capacity based: §4 (p0107, p0119) Segment ownership per Schedule B; §12 (p0187, p0210, p0214) capacity ownership; IRU definition (p0054). Data handling in §31 Confidentiality (p0270-p0273). No transfer of our IP/data to counterparties spotted.

Licence analogue is the Terminal Station Right of Use (§11: p0179, p0182, p0183) and IRU (p0054), with resale/extension rights at p0206, p0208. Test scope, duration (life of system), no extra charges, and revocability.

§9 Keeping and Inspection of Books (p0160) with review/audit right at 9.8 (p0167). Mutual right over Segment S/T cost records rather than vendor audit of our usage; check notice, frequency, cost bearing.

§23 Default (p0255, p0256): late payment consequences and reclamation of capacity with no payment or credit to the defaulting Party; default interest p0153; no credit on termination p0233. Assess penalty character against us.

Express disclaimer: PG makes no representations or warranties (p0126); nothing construed as a warranty or guarantee (p0127). Check whether Supplier warranties pass through via §4/§10 before concluding deviation.

Insurance appears only as a cost category: allowance in lieu of insurance (p0133) and optional joint insurance charged to Capital Costs (p0139). No obligation to maintain specified coverage; confirm and treat as missing if so.

Commitment is structural: Minimum Investment Unit (p0055) and Investment Shares/cost allocation per Schedule B (p0040), with default interest p0153. Read §§5-7 and §§13-14 for ongoing funding obligations and exit relief (cf. §18 no-credit rule).

Post-exit mechanics in §18 (realization of assets, Schedule adjustment, transfer documents at p0234, p0235) and surviving liabilities p0280; confidentiality survives five years (p0274). No data-return or transition-assistance obligation identified; confirm.
